prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—it depends on whether you need AI-search visibility, paid media, automation, or broader marketing.

**For AI search visibility (showing up in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI results), Thrive is one option worth shortlisting.** Its published Los Angeles case studies report gains in ChatGPT traffic and AI Overview mentions, alongside traditional SEO results. Those are agency-reported outcomes, so ask for references and results relevant to your industry before deciding.

Also compare **LAv1** for a local mix of AI visibility, SEO, paid ads, and web design, and **Single Grain** for broader growth marketing and AI-focused services.

When evaluating them, ask how they measure qualified leads—not just AI mentions or traffic—and request a recent case study for a business like yours.
